Sobre a Organização

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

Missão

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

Visão

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

Valores

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Infrastructure Engineer role at Keyrock

3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Keyrock
Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.

Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, also soon to be Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.

But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join our team, focusing on AWS, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps best practices. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining highly scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure to support our trading operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cloud computing, automation, and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high availability and performance for mission-critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cloud Infrastructure Management: Design, deploy, and maintain scalable and resilient infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).
  • Kubernetes Administration: Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized applications, ensuring high availability and security.
  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment, testing, and monitoring of applications.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Develop comprehensive monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar tools to improve system reliability.
  • Security & Compliance: Apply best practices for cloud security, IAM policies, and compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Incident Response & Performance Optimization: Troubleshoot issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement fixes to optimize performance.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Work closely with developers, security teams, and operations to promote DevOps culture and best practices.
  • Disaster Recovery & Reliability Engineering: Design failover and backup strategies to ensure business continuity in the event of failures.

Background And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps roles.
  • Interest in or any exposure to trading or similar themes would be desirable (not essential)

Competences and personality

  • Strong expertise in AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS, K3s, or self-managed clusters).
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible).
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (VPC, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls).
  • Experience with DevOps methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps practices.
  • Experience with high-performance and low-latency (sub millisecond) systems.
  • Familiarity with serverless architectures and event-driven computing.
  • Exposure to cloud cost optimization and FinOps strategies.
  • Previous exposure working with Crypto, Traditional Finance (Trad Fi) or Trading would be highly desirable but not essential

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Our offer

  • A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on method of engagement (Employee vs Contractor)
  • Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

Responsabilidades

  • Captação de Imóveis: Identificar oportunidades de mercado e captar imóveis para locação que atendam às necessidades e expectativas dos clientes da NOVI.

  • Habilidades: Excelência em comunicação interpessoal, negociação, análise de mercado e capacidade de construir e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo.

Na NOVI, simplificamos o processo de locação de imóveis, tornando-o acessível e descomplicado para todos os envolvidos. Nossa abordagem focada no cliente, transparente e eficiente, garante uma experiência positiva e segura para proprietários e locatários.

Acreditamos que o lar é um espaço de bem-estar e que todos têm o direito de encontrar o lugar ideal de forma simples e justa. Nosso compromisso é transformar o mercado imobiliário, colocando as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos.

  • Inovação: Adotar soluções tecnológicas e processos eficientes para melhorar continuamente nossos serviços.
  • Responsabilidade: Agir com ética e respeito, assumindo a responsabilidade por nossas ações e seus impactos.

title: Talent Sourcer
description:
WHO IS PROSANA

We are all about people at Prosana, and helping everyone we engage with find a sense of purpose in their work. That's the number one value that we share inside and out!

We're a recruitment and team growth company that works with eCommerce startups and digital marketing agencies, helping them find, hire, and develop performance-based talent—from Media Buyers and Creative Strategists to Email Marketers & CRO Specialists.

YOUR MISSION

Your primary mission is to serve as the go-to expert for pinpointing and identifying top-quality candidates in the performance marketing and e-commerce space. You will use the latest headhunting tools and techniques to discover high-potential talent and add them to our pipeline for further review by our recruitment team. By uncovering strong leads, you’ll play a critical role in helping Prosana deliver on its promise to place the right people in the right roles for maximum impact.

This is a full-time contractor role.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  1. Fully remote and flexible working schedule that doesn't restrict you to just one location, and you'll be able to work when you feel most productive.
  2. Access to courses, books, & CEOs network to boost your knowledge base and become a specialist in your field.
  3. Work closely with a lean, high-performing team where your contributions are directly tied to the company’s success—a great addition to your portfolio and career story.
  4. Be part of a team that thrives on new ideas, embraces challenges, and celebrates success together—no matter how small.

HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME

  1. Strategically identifying and engaging top-tier candidates for performance marketing and e-commerce roles using advanced headhunting tools and techniques.
  2. Leveraging platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Boolean search methods, specialized job boards, and referral networks to build robust pipelines of passive and active talent.
  3. Crafting and refining outreach messaging to attract high-caliber candidates and effectively communicate role specifics.
  4. Coordinating with internal recruiters to understand role requirements, ensuring alignment in candidate qualifications and experience.
  5. Maintaining a well-organized and up-to-date candidate database via our ATS, tracking progress and insights at each stage.
  6. Continuously researching and evaluating new sourcing platforms, tools, and methods to stay ahead of competitive hiring markets.
  7. Monitoring industry trends and talent markets to proactively adjust sourcing strategies for niche skill sets.

WHO YOU ARE

  1. You have hands-on experience in candidate sourcing, focusing on international talent for performance marketing and/or e-commerce roles.
  2. You are an expert in advanced headhunting tools and techniques (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Boolean searches, automation tools, etc.).
  3. You thrive on designing innovative sourcing strategies and experimenting with new methods to connect with specialized talent.
  4. You excel at juggling multiple sourcing campaigns simultaneously while maintaining high levels of quality and productivity.
  5. You’re committed to continuous learning and staying on top of the latest sourcing trends and best practices.
  6. You are tech-savvy and comfortable with CRM and ATS systems.
  7. You appreciate lean work methodologies and continuously look for ways to streamline and optimize your sourcing efforts.

Este profissional desempenha um papel crucial na manutenção e operação eficiente dos equipamentos e sistemas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, mecânicos e estruturais, garantindo o funcionamento adequado e seguro dos equipamentos e instalações.

  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter informado sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.
  • Responder a chamadas de emergência e realizar reparos urgentes para minimizar o tempo de inatividade e garantir a continuidade das operações.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo ou técnico na área de elétrica ou áreas relacionadas.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

Como Se Preparar Para o Processo Seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural.

Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

Job description

Nossa área de Estratégia e Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido - Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo



Main responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Trabalhar em times de alta performance para desenvolver e manter ferramentas de: provisionamento, configuração, deploy e monitoração de diferentes stacks em uma infraestrutura escalável e resiliente;
  • Compreender os desafios e as necessidades de um projeto, tanto no âmbito de operações da infraestrutura quanto no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Buscar soluções para sustentar as estratégias e as metas de negócio;
  • Automatizar tarefas do pipeline de integração e entrega de software;
  • Fazer a gestão de capacidade de infraestrutura;
  • Analisar o desempenho de sistemas e implementar soluções para problemas de performance;
  • Tratar incidentes e participar da análise e solução de sua causa raiz;
  • Trabalho colaborativo com diversas áreas;
  • Trabalhar com soluções que fazem parte de projetos de grande audiência e repercussão.


Requirements and skills

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência de Sysadmin em: Configuração, resolução de problemas e otimização de Sistemas Operacionais Linux e redes;
  • Experiência de instalação e configuração de web server Nginx;
  • Experiência de automação de deploy e versionamento de software (Git, Gitlab, Artfactory, etc);
  • Experiência em soluções de virtualização e orquestração de containers como: Kubernetes, Docker etc;
  • Experiência em clouds públicas como: GCP, AWS e Azure;
  • Experiência em observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix);
  • Experiência em práticas ágeis;
  • Infraestrutura de aplicações web de alta escala;
  • Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible).

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Experiência em cloud pública (GCP);
  • Experiência em plataformas de gerenciamento de ADs (Google Admanager, FreeWheel).


Additional information

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo

Seguindo o compromisso de contribuir para um ambiente seguro para nossas pessoas, informamos que ter o esquema completo vacinação contra a Covid-19 é uma condição obrigatória para o trabalho na Globo, presencial ou a distância, e que o comprovante deverá ser apresentado como pré-requisito para a contratação.

Professional Services Architect

As customers' security infrastructure becomes more complex, Fortinet Professional Services experts are positioned to help them every step of the way. We’ve accumulated many years of experience to assist our customers with their security design, deployment, operation, and optimization needs. The Professional Services Architect is a key member of the LATAM Professional Services organization, serving as a customer-facing technical point of contact, guiding and overseeing technical aspects during solution, transition, and delivery phases. This role involves providing services delivery expertise to ensure a correct solution leading to a smooth transition of systems and processes, aligning with architecture principles.   • Solid technical expertise in system architecture and design.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand business requirements and technical constraints during solution, transitional, and delivery phases.
  • Provide remote and onsite technical consulting expertise in the development of the solution, transition, and delivery strategies, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles.
  • Test existing systems and processes, identifying technical requirements and potential challenges during both transition and delivery.
  • Support the design and architect solutions, considering scalability, security, and efficiency.
  • Work closely with project teams to ensure the implementation of the solutions aligns with the overall strategy.
  • Conduct reviews and assessments to ensure compliance with architecture principles and best practices.
  • Provide guidance and support to development teams during the implementation of solutions.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies.

title: [Interaction Platform] Software Engineer Mobile Sr Android / KMP
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O time de Interaction Platform:

O time de Interaction Platform tem o propósito de facilitar o desenvolvimento de experiências multiplataforma com alta qualidade e eficiência, reduzindo os custos e o tempo que levamos para evoluir os produtos e melhorar a experiência de nossos(as) clientes.

Nossa responsabilidade é construir plataformas (Ex: mobile, web, terminais, conversacionais) e os padrões de experiência globais através do design system, viabilizando a criação de funcionalidades de forma única, padronizada e com mais agilidade, permitindo que os demais times da Stone consigam evoluir as soluções de forma eficiente e evitando a necessidade de aumentar nossos custos de operação ao desenvolver inúmeras vezes uma mesma aplicação para atender diferentes consumidores.

Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineer Mobile Sr.

Você terá um papel de grande influência técnica no time, com a missão de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento, que irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, com atuação "hands on" onde precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, atuará no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma mobile na Stone.

Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Interaction Platform, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de mobile.

O que esperamos de você:
  • Ter interesse em trabalhar com adoção de novas tecnologias e aprender mais sobre KMP;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Android, incluindo Kotlin e Jetpack Compose;
  • Experiência em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
  • Experiência em investigação, troubleshooting e depuração de sistemas.
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, serviços em nuvem (por exemplo, Firebase), armazenamento local e remoto de dados, autenticação e notificações push;
  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI/CD, pipeline automatizado;
  • Conhecimentos de arquitetura de módulos e componentização;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Testes unitários, testes de integração, testes funcionais e testes de snapshots, utilizando ferramentas como JUnit, Espresso, Mockito, XCTest, Snapshot Testing, entre outras;
  • Publicação de apps (Play Store e/ou App Store);
  • Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban.
O que aumenta as suas chances:
  • Conhecimentos em KMP - Kotlin Multiplataforma;
  • Familiaridade com gerenciadores de dependência (CocoaPods, Carthage, SPM), Fastlane;
  • Experiência em Android Studio e Gradle;
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento com React Native;
  • Contribuição em projetos Open Source;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Design System com compreensão dos princípios de design systems, incluindo componentização, padronização de UI/UX, uso de bibliotecas de componentes, diretrizes de design e padrões de interface;
  • Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros e/ou apps de larga escala;
Nossos benefícios:

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

description:
São Paulo - SP

ATRIBUIÇÕES PRINCIPAIS
  1. Executar os procedimentos privativos e relacionados a práticas avançadas de enfermagem como interagir com pais/ responsáveis antes, durante e após procedimentos, orientações realizadas, realizar e orientar diluições e rediluições de medicamentos conforme faixa etária/ peso/ restrição hídrica, realizar punção venosa considerando protocolo de punção difícil para todas as crianças, acompanhar pacientes em exames com sedação e realizar procedimentos invasivos específicos como punção venosa, atendimento de urgência;
  2. Realizar procedimentos invasivos preferencialmente em dupla através das diretrizes do modelo assistencial para garantir as melhores práticas institucionais;
  3. Receber o plantão e proceder a assistência direta aos pacientes, observando, acompanhando, reconhecendo sinais/sintomas e registrando as ações e, ao término do plantão informar e esclarecer a assistência prestada aos pacientes através da passagem de plantão em instrumento estruturado institucional;
  4. Realizar e planejar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE) estabelecendo níveis de responsabilidade na execução das ações planejadas entre equipe de enfermagem, avaliando os resultados e registrando-os durante a internação, através das necessidades de cada paciente.
  5. Coordenar processos que garantam uma assistência segura e de qualidade a todos os pacientes sob sua responsabilidade nas diferentes situações críticas, através das diretrizes institucionais, a fim de garantir uma assistência segura;
  6. Aprazar e conferir os itens de prescrição médica para continuidade da assistência segura;
  7. Reconhecer e priorizar de acordo com a complexidade assistencial as situações de emergência mediante a necessidade de cada paciente, direcionando a assistência a ser prestada, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as normas, regulamentos e legislações pertinentes às áreas de atuação, contribuir para a elaboração e implementação de manuais técnicos operacionais para a equipe de enfermagem nos diversos setores de atuação e de manuais educativos aos clientes e familiares;
  8. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares;
  9. Apoiar demais setores, conforme direcionamento de liderança, viabilizando o atendimento de todos os pacientes internados no HSC;
  10. Participação ativa em visita multidisciplinar buscando o alinhamento das necessidades assistenciais dos pacientes e familiares sob sua responsabilidade;
  11. Garantir a comunicação ativa junto a equipe multidisciplinar visando facilitar o planejamento e execução das ações pertinentes as boas práticas e contribuir com o desenvolvimento do colaborador, através de educação em atividades baseadas em normas, protocolos e procedimentos institucionais, visando a atualização e aperfeiçoamento da equipe de enfermagem;
  12. Realizar o acompanhamento e treinamento de colaboradores recém-admitidos, com exercício de mesma função assistencial;
  13. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais;
  14. Exercer as atividades baseado nos protocolos institucionais na busca da prevenção e controle sistemático de danos a pacientes durante a assistência de saúde através do cumprimento das metas de segurança do paciente;
  15. Participar dos treinamentos e eventos institucionais pertinentes ao cargo;
  16. Multiplicar informações relacionadas a boas práticas assistenciais junto a equipe multidisciplinar de área de atuação, promovendo e difundindo medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente;
  17. Realizar notificações de não conformidades e eventos identificados visando manter a qualidade e segurança da assistência prestada;
  18. Executar as práticas de segurança através do cumprimento das normativas da NR-32, medicina ocupacional, SCIH e SEST.
Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a ACSC é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com uma abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para o estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós:

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  1. Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  2. Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  3. Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  4. Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  5. Garantir a continuidade da Assistência em Fisioterapia, por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.
  6. Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido.

Join to apply for the Lead HR Generalist - Americas role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region

The role entails

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
  • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team
  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice to have skills

  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Recognition rewards

  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

At Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have leadership attributes, deep knowledge of Linux, and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You have experience programming in Python and Go
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Este banco de talentos abrange oportunidades para Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo.

  • Graduação em cursos de Ciência de Dados, Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em modelagens de dados, Power BI e outras ferramentas de BI, SQL e Python.

Você se destaca se tiver:

  • MBA/Pós Graduação em temas relacionados a Data Science, Analytics ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em Python, R ou ferramentas de análise de dados como Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-learn (para Python) ou Tidyverse (para R).
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de machine learning e bibliotecas como TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn ou Spark.
  • Conhecimento em Big Data, ferramentas de processamento de dados (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka) ou ferramentas de armazenamento de dados (Hadoop, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage).

title: Channel Marketing Director
description:

Join to apply for the Channel Marketing Director role at Canonical

5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include major public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with over 1200 colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet in person 2-4 times a year in interesting locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director , to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading open source provider, we play a vital role in innovative value chains like Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, and IoT, supporting our partners technically and commercially.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will lead a team of marketing managers managing partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner for open source-based products and solutions. You will be responsible for maximizing the ROI of our campaigns supporting various partner sales motions.

The partner marketing team comprises talented professionals skilled in formulating joint value propositions, running lead generation campaigns, creating impactful messages/assets, and selecting effective channels through complex supply chains. They are passionate about technology, enterprise users, and advanced partner analytics technologies.

Location: This role is home-based in the AMER region.

The role entails:

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue through key partners such as Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, and GSI.
  • Aligning with growth, field, and product marketing to deliver integrated activities.
  • Executing partner campaigns from recruitment to demand generation.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community with exceptional content.
  • Multiplying partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Creating bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out.
  • Championing partner collaboration internally and externally.
  • Managing Marketing Development Funds (MDF) usage.
  • Driving adoption of analytics and reporting tools to improve ROI.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers.
  • Cultivating a culture of testing and optimization.

What we are looking for in you

  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud providers, and channels.
  • Leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven success in co-marketing programs in the tech space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities.
  • Ability to foster a culture of excellence, agility, and self-drive.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning habits.
  • Outstanding English communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Excellent academic results at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events.

Additional preferred experience:

  • Familiarity with specific verticals like Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across time zones.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation review and performance bonuses.
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, maternity/paternity leave.
  • Wellness programs and travel opportunities.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneer in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We recruit globally, set high standards, and expect excellence. Most colleagues work remotely, and working here challenges you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Job Description

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience:

  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

It Would Be Nice If You Have:

  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.

Reporting Relationships:

The incumbent reports to a senior level engineer or technical manager. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Works

Job Description

Structural Engineer performs engineering design review, calculation, and advanced structural analysis assignments, usually involving a significant project or several smaller or less complex projects. These projects require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in engineering or science. Through broader and more technically challenging work, the engineer will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Do:
  • Perform detailed engineering reviews of plans for compliance with applicable rules, regulations, and contracts, with minimal supervision.
  • Provide technical advice to field operations and other technical teams.
  • Address moderately complex problems, including conflicting design requirements and material standards.
  • Conduct advanced structural analysis for offshore installations and marine vessels using finite element methods and hand calculations.
  • Evaluate asset remaining life through structural assessments.
  • Propose new approaches and recommend changes to methods, procedures, or designs.
  • Draft technically accurate reports and respond to communications promptly.
  • Collaborate with clients to resolve technical problems.
  • Prepare weekly reports and billing documentation.
  • Communicate workload status to team members to meet client needs.
  • Work as part of a team but may operate autonomously.
  • Maintain ABS Quality System requirements following training.
What You Will Need:Education and Experience
  • B.S. in Civil, Structural, Naval Architecture, Mechanical, Ocean Engineering, or related fields with 5 years of experience in O&G projects, shipyard, design/consulting, or classification society.
  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • Experience with Finite Element Method (coursework or research).
Professional License

Professional or chartered engineering license preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Understanding of classification and quality concepts, practices, and procedures.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Willingness to learn ABS systems.
Additional Skills (Nice to Have):
  • Knowledge of ABS software (EAGLE, OSAP).
  • Experience with FEMAP/NX, NASTRAN, Ansys, ABAQUS, SACS, hydrodynamics software.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a senior engineer or technical manager. No direct reports.

ABS Group has over 160 years of promoting safety at sea and environmental preservation. We support organizations navigating evolving regulations and technologies, supporting safety, reliability, and efficiency in marine and offshore sectors.

description:
Objetivo do Cargo:

Responsável por realizar a limpeza e organização de ambientes, garantindo que todos os produtos e utensílios necessários estejam disponíveis para o desempenho das atividades. Deve zelar pela conservação dos espaços e informar à equipe responsável sobre qualquer irregularidade ou necessidade de reposição.


Qualificações e Requisitos:

  1. Ensino Fundamental Completo
  2. Experiência prévia em atividades de limpeza e organização (desejável)
  3. Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de seguir instruções
  4. Boa comunicação para reportar situações de falta de materiais ou danos
  5. Proatividade e responsabilidade

Competências Desejáveis:

  1. Organização e capacidade de multitarefa
  2. Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe
  3. Boa disposição física para atividades de limpeza e movimentação de objetos

Condições de Trabalho:

  1. Jornada de trabalho conforme cronograma diário estabelecido.
  2. Ambiente de trabalho residencial, com foco na conservação e limpeza.
  3. Verificação de Materiais: Verificar a sacola de trabalho no início do expediente para garantir que todos os produtos e materiais necessários para as atividades do dia estejam presentes. Conferir e seguir o cronograma diário de tarefas, assegurando que a bolsa de kit esteja corretamente equipada conforme as necessidades do dia.
  4. Limpeza e Organização: Realizar a retirada de roupas sujas conforme as instruções e necessidades da casa. Executar as atividades de faxina conforme o planejamento, incluindo a limpeza de superfícies, pisos, móveis e outros ambientes. Realizar a arrumação de cômodos, garantindo que os espaços fiquem organizados e limpos, conforme os padrões estabelecidos.
  5. Manutenção e Acompanhamento: Observar atentamente o estado de conservação da casa, identificando qualquer dano ou necessidade de reparos, e comunicar imediatamente à equipe responsável. Monitorar a falta de objetos ou utensílios essenciais para o funcionamento da casa, sinalizando à equipe responsável quando houver a necessidade de reposição.
  6. Organização da Lavanderia: Após a execução das atividades de limpeza, retirar a roupa suja da bolsa e organizar apropriadamente no local destinado à lavanderia.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Proporcionar a eficiência e a gestão eficaz dos contratos de bens e serviços, sejam eles na modalidade SPOT ou contratação estratégica, por meio de análises, monitoramento contínuo e ações proativas.

  • Colaborar com a equipe técnica e de gestão na elaboração de critérios de medição de escopos de contratos, realizando reuniões de alinhamento para garantir a exequibilidade e confiança na medição das execuções contratuais.
  • Desenvolver KPIs de eficiência e identificar possíveis riscos nos contratos por meio de pesquisas periódicas.

Join to apply for the Software Engineer - Python - Ubuntu Pro client - graduate level role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to develop, test and release improvements to the Ubuntu Pro client.

Ubuntu Pro is a suite of specialist services provided by Canonical. Whether for enterprise customers deploying systems at scale or users who want security patching for their personal Ubuntu LTS at home, the Ubuntu Pro Client is the command-line tool that manages all these services.

The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. You will also be a voice in communication with our users, ensuring their needs are met.

This role requires quality-oriented software engineering in Python and a focus on software interoperability over a vast range of target releases and environments. Excellent Python skills are a key requirement, with previous contributions to open source Python projects being an advantage. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.

Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Pro client is used at all ranges, from mission-critical environments to hobbyist Ubuntu users; applicants should be ready to work with the whole spectrum of end users and help guide engineering best practices with all of them in mind.

The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code, with unit and functional tests, to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and investigate to find good solutions
  • Work from home, with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have extensive experience with Python on Linux
  • You have interest in and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux systems administration, continuous integration, end-system contract management, Debian packaging, working with public or on premise clouds
  • Bonus points if you have experience engaging with the open source community

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Qualifications

title: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)
description:
Neo4j is the leader in Graph Database & Analytics, helping organizations uncover hidden patterns and relationships across billions of data connections deeply, easily, and quickly. Customers use Neo4j to gain a deeper understanding of their business and reveal new ways of solving their most pressing problems. Over 84% of Fortune 100 companies use Neo4j, along with a vibrant community of 250,000+ developers, data scientists, and architects across the globe.

At Neo4j, we’re proud to build the technology that powers breakthrough solutions for our customers. These solutions have helped NASA get to Mars two years earlier, broke the Panama Papers for the ICIJ, and are helping Transport for London to cut congestion by 10% and save $750M a year. Some of our other notable customers include Intuit, Lockheed Martin, Novartis, UBS, and Walmart.

Neo4j experienced rapid growth this year as organizations looking to deploy generative AI (GenAI) recognized graph databases as essential for improving it’s accuracy, transparency, and explainability. Growth was further fueled by enterprise demand for Neo4j’s cloud offering and partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and ecosystem leaders. Learn more at neo4j.com and follow us on LinkedIn .

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

JOB TITLE: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)

Location : Ideally based in or near São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil OR Miami, FL,. Travel will be required especially if based outside of São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview As a key driver of revenue growth in our LATAM region, particularly in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our ambitious revenue targets. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) who can craft and execute high-impact marketing strategies and demand generation programs that align with regional pipeline and revenue objectives.

Reporting Structure The Senior RMM will be an integral member of our Americas Marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Americas Marketing. This role requires building robust partnerships with the Neo4j LATAM sales team and collaborating effectively with various departments, including corporate marketing, digital, developer relations, communications (PR), and product marketing, to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Development : Formulate and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for the LATAM region, incorporating digital marketing, partnerships, public relations (in collaboration with an agency and the communications team), account-based marketing (ABM), and event initiatives aimed at generating leads, opportunities, and deals.
  • Performance Accountability : Lead the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to meet key performance indicators, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Continuously evaluate and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs to enhance execution, efficiency, and overall results.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work collaboratively across all marketing functions to design and implement effective lead generation programs, encompassing digital initiatives, corporate events, and webinars.
  • Event Coordination : Define and implement LATAM-specific events and demand generation programs, including owned events, roadshows, workshops, and participation in third-party conferences. This includes audience segmentation, registration management, promotion, lead handling, and outcome tracking.
  • Channel Partnership : Cultivate and expand engagement with regional channel partners (GCP and AWS) through joint marketing initiatives.
  • Sales Development Partnership : Work closely with Sales Development teams to gather feedback, ensuring timely and effective follow-up on leads.
  • Strategic Communication : Effectively communicate marketing strategies, value propositions, positioning, and messaging to the LATAM sales team, ensuring they are equipped with the latest, most compelling content for effective sales cycles.
  • PR : Assist in facilitating customer and press participation in local activities, including press releases, case studies, event presentations, and industry awards.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be a key member of the Americas Regional Marketing team. The team is responsible for driving the highest quality lead generation programs that take customers and prospects through their buyers’ journey using all activities in the marketing mix including digital, partner and event programs.

As a Senior Regional Marketer, you will drive opportunities and pipeline growth by developing and executing on a quarterly marketing plan based on approved budgets. You’ll recommend digital programs, specific regional activities and local events, and determine what demand generation content needs will drive business results for the region. This position requires significant cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

  • Languages : Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is required for this role. While not required, proficiency in Spanish is considered a strong plus.
  • 7+ years in Regional Marketing, with a proven track record in developing and executing pipeline-generation programs, digital initiatives, and events. Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) is a plus.
  • 5+ years collaborating on PR and thought leadership strategies for regional growth.
  • Strong demand generation expertise, analytical abilities, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience in event planning, execution, and post-event analysis.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to meet goals.
  • Goal-oriented self-starter with a proactive, independent work style who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead projects from concept to completion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to work at both the tactical and strategic levels, including effective budget management and ROI optimization.
  • Technical Proficiency : Advanced knowledge of Marketo, Tableau and Salesforce is essential.
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph database in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.
  • Neo4j was named as a Visionary in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Database Management Systems among 19 other recognized global DBMS vendors. Neo4j was also ranked as a Strong Performer among 14 top vendors in The Forrester Wave: Vector Databases, Q3 2024.

General Requirements

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.

  • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre-job meeting.
  • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.

Hse Requirements

  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Coach personnel to use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Use WorkSight COACH during the execution of planned work and daily operations to reinforce Company requirements.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations. Ensure reported situations are acknowledged properly.
  • Ensure the Control of Work process is complied with when planning and managing the execution of work.
  • Ensure major accident barriers / controls are maintained.
  • Ensure safe and organized work areas are maintained.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Lead or participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.
  • Ensure change is properly controlled and managed.

Duties

The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. Operations/Maintenance

GENERAL DUTIES:

  • Coordinate and ensure that all mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment maintenance and repair is done in a safe and prudent manner.
  • Ensure conformance to policies, local and international regulations relating to the operation of the rig, and current pollution regulations.
  • Monitor the power plants’ controls and power distribution; ensure that power is available at all times.
  • Ensure that the permit to work and isolation system is in place and followed.
  • Participate in the effective management of the AIM (Asset & Inventory Management) system and ensure all records are maintained on a timely basis.

  • Carry out equipment periodic maintenance according to AIM guidelines and coordinate same with First Engineer.
  • Ensure that reports for repair and maintenance of equipment are accurate and complete.
  • Carry out classification society surveys as part of continuous survey of machinery.
  • Assist the First Engineer in ensuring that all third-party equipment is fit for purpose, certified, correctly installed, and maintained while on the rig.
  • In conjunction with the First Engineer, monitor and control the use and distribution of consumables/materials; generate requisitions as required.
  • Maintain an adequate supply of spares to fulfill maintenance requirements and facilitate a safe and efficient operation.
  • Inform the First Engineer of any technical problems or limitations that may affect the safe operation of the rig.
  • Implement outstanding recommendations from audits, as issued by Clients, Regulatory Authorities or rig management.
  • Assist the First Engineer in supplying information for maintenance and repair budget.
  • Assist in communicating equipment problems or breakdown with Field Support group and equipment vendors.

Personnel

  • Promote and maintain good working relationships with other departments, third-party personnel and Customer representatives.
  • Ensure all Maintenance personnel meet the training requirements as per their applicable training matrix.
  • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work at their next job level.
  • Provide leadership and motivation to the maintenance crews. Apply continuous improvement process.
